cohort: 5,718 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants from 21 neonatal departments registered in the database of the Premature Baby Foundation of Taiwan, including 844 infants with maternal preeclampsia.
finding: Maternal preeclampsia was not associated with the subsequent development of any stage or severe ROP in VLBW infants.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with mild and severe ROP development in univariable analysis.
